title: QR Code Management
description: Create and manage QR codes for courses, quizzes, and AI subscriptions, either individually or in a combined bundle.

create.title: Create QR bundle
create.description: Choose one or more grant types. You can generate up to 500 codes for the same bundle.

generated.title: QR codes created
generated.description: The codes were added to the list. You can print them now or download all of them in one PDF file.
generated.downloadHint: Use Print to open the print dialog, or Download all PDF to save a ready file containing every code.

modes.all: Everything available when the code is created
modes.snapshot: A snapshot of all currently published {{title}} will be stored, so content added later will not be included automatically.

validation.courseRequired: Select at least one course or choose all courses.
validation.quizRequired: Select at least one quiz or choose all quizzes.
validation.grantRequired: Select at least one course, quiz, or AI subscription grant.
validation.countRange: The code count must be between 1 and 500.
validation.validDaysRange: Validity must be between 1 and 3650 days.
